# 定义函数incrementer，使每个玩家的分数增加1
def incrementer(dictionary):

    # for循环遍历字典
    # 并将分数增加1
    for key in dictionary:
        dictionary[key] += 1

    # 打印更新后的字典
    print(dictionary)


# 定义字典
player_scores = eval(input())

# 调用函数
incrementer(player_scores)
